verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Postgres Row Level Security as in-database authorization, including a concrete per-user policy using `auth.uid() = user_id`. RLS also covers Storage file permissions, and the publishable key is confined to what RLS allows. Advisors flag misconfigured RLS policies, and community developers report building apps on RLS (one after initial pains). Missing for 10: community-reported RLS modeling limitations (e.g. splitting user data across multiple tables) leave one rough edge not addressed by the docs.
